_comment: /etc/notify/apps.json (640 root:root) — who notify tells, per app. Secrets are never in here: each channel names the root-only dotenv file it reads them from. Channel types: ntfy (topic_key, default NTFY_TOPIC, from env_file, default the secrets file; optional server), mail (the app's own MAIL_* from env_file; the recipient as to, or as to_key in that file, default APP_CONTACT), discord (webhook_key, default DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, from env_file), file (path; for trying a configuration). A unit belongs to the app its name starts with (mixtape-restic.service -> mixtape); the name is also what waf-report's apps.json refers to. host is the box itself — smartd's disk warnings, through smartd-notify — with the ntfy channel only: the box has no mail account of its own.
